title: Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction

paragraphs.en: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting : predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE / TIDES : TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“交互式4D体素液体预测”这一任务：根据固体物体在液体中的运动方式，预测未来密集3D液体速度场的时空演化。 这项任务为需要推理运动条件对液体响应影响的系统提供了上游物理预测基础，包括机器人液体操控、数字孪生以及刚体-流体视频生成。 现有研究已在预测静态或预设固体几何形状周围的流动，以及合成视觉上合理的流体运动方面取得了一定成果。 然而，这些方法对交互式液体动力学的覆盖范围有限，因为它们无法预测移动固体如何引发未来整个域内的液体响应。 在此预测场景中，流体动力学效应集中在不断变化的液-固界面附近，但预测目标是一个全局的时空演化过程。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种两级循环预测框架 TIDE / TIDES：TIDE 专门处理局部界面驱动的预测，而 TIDES 则增加了传输感知的耦合机制和显式稳定化手段，以减少累积的预测误差。 在适配的邻近基线模型、受控组件消融实验、运动/尺寸分布外测试以及长期预测评估中，TIDES 实现了最佳的预测性能，而消融分析表明局部相互作用、传输耦合和稳定化是其主要贡献因素。 综上所述，我们的任务定义、基准测试以及 TIDE/TIDES 研究共同构建了一个受控的基础框架，用于支持基于移动固体条件的密集液体预测。 代码可在 https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES 公开获取。

paragraphs.en: When a solid object moves through liquid, its motion first creates disturbances near the evolving solid–liquid interface, and these local disturbances propagate into a global flow response over time ( Kolahdouz et al., 2021 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2026 ; Zhong and Meidani, 2025 ) . We formalize this setting as the task of interactive 4D volumetric liquid forecasting : given an initial liquid state and a future moving-solid trajectory, the goal is to predict the future dense 3D liquid velocity field over the full domain. This task asks whether a model can infer not only where liquid particles move, but also how the full volumetric liquid state evolves as an explicit physical field when a solid object moves, pushes, stirs, or passes through the liquid.
paragraphs.zh: 当固体物体在液体中运动时，其运动首先会在不断演化的固液界面附近产生扰动，而这些局部扰动会随着时间的推移传播为全局的流场响应（Kolahdouz 等人，2021；Xiao 等人，2024；Tao 等人，2026；Zhong 和 Meidani，2025）。 我们将这一设定形式化为交互式四维体液体预测任务：给定初始液体状态和未来的固体运动轨迹，目标是预测整个域内未来密集的三维液体速度场。 该任务旨在检验模型是否能够推断出液体粒子的运动位置，以及当固体物体在液体中运动、推动、搅动或穿过液体时，整个体液体状态如何以显式物理场的形式演化。

paragraphs.en: This capability provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for interactive systems that must reason about motion-conditioned liquid response. In robotic liquid manipulation, a system may need to compare candidate pouring, stirring, scooping, or pushing motions before acting ( Midlagajni and Rothkopf, 2025 ) . In digital twins and simulation-driven design, operators may wish to ask how changes in a moving tool, actuator, or trajectory alter the surrounding flow state ( Kochkov et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023c ) . In rigid–fluid video generation and future 4D world models, realistic interaction requires not only moving the rigid object correctly, but also producing coherent wakes, waves, and other liquid responses induced by that motion ( Akkerman et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ) . These settings motivate a reusable forecasting primitive for repeated querying: many candidate solid motions can be evaluated under a shared physical scene.
paragraphs.zh: 这种能力为交互式系统提供了一个上游物理预测基础模块，这些系统必须对受运动条件影响的液体响应进行推理。 在机器人液体操控中，一个系统在执行操作前可能需要比较候选的倾倒、搅拌、舀取或推动动作（Midlagajni and Rothkopf, 2025）。 在数字孪生和模拟驱动的设计中，操作员可能希望了解移动工具、执行器或轨迹的变化如何改变周围的流动状态（Kochkov et al., 2021; Li et al., 2023c）。 在刚体–流体视频生成和未来4D世界模型中，逼真的交互不仅需要正确移动刚体，还需要产生连贯的尾迹、波浪以及由该运动引发的其他液体响应（Akkerman et al., 2025; Shi et al., 2024; Jia et al., 2025）。 这些应用场景促使我们开发一个可重复使用的预测基础模块，用于多次查询：许多候选的固体运动都可以在共享的物理场景中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Existing learned flow models address related but incomplete settings. Neural operators and CFD surrogates have made substantial progress in efficient field prediction, operator learning, and geometry-aware surrogate modeling ( Li et al., 2020 ; Kovachki et al., 2023 ; Rahman et al., 2022 ; Wen et al., 2022 ; Tran et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023b ) . However, these methods typically focus on operator regression, geometry-conditioned prediction, or flow around static or prescribed solid geometries, rather than forecasting the evolving liquid response induced by a moving solid. Volumetric flow enhancement methods learn dense velocity fields, but usually reconstruct or enhance already observed measurements rather than predict future motion-conditioned liquid response ( Ferdian et al., 2020 ; Rutkowski et al., 2021 ; Suk et al., 2026 ) . Visual rigid–fluid synthesis methods can generate plausible fluid appearance, but they often do not provide an explicit dense physical state that can be reused for rollout, querying, or downstream reasoning ( Akkerman et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . Particle-, mesh-, and graph-based learned dynamics capture local interactions in simulator-native representations, but their primary prediction space is not a full-domain dense Eulerian volume ( Pfaff et al., 2020 ; Gaoa et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, scene-flow methods estimate 3D motion fields, but they target scene or point motion rather than physically explicit liquid-state forecasting ( Li et al., 2023a ; Vedder et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) . Together, these limitations open the problem of forecasting full-domain liquid response under time-varying solid interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的学习流模型处理的是相关但不完整的设定。 神经算子和计算流体力学（CFD）代理模型在高效场预测、算子学习和几何感知代理建模方面取得了显著进展（Li et al., 2020；Kovachki et al., 2023；Rahman et al., 2022；Wen et al., 2022；Tran et al., 2021；Li et al., 2023b）。 然而，这些方法通常专注于算子回归、几何条件预测，或静态或预设固体几何结构周围的流场，而非预测由移动固体引发的动态液体响应。 体积流增强方法能够学习密集的速度场，但通常只是重构或增强已观测到的测量数据，而非预测未来受运动条件影响的液体响应（Ferdian et al., 2020；Rutkowski et al., 2021；Suk et al., 2026）。 视觉刚体–流体合成方法可以生成逼真的流体外观，但它们通常无法提供可用于后续模拟、查询或下游推理的显式密集物理状态（Akkerman et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2024；Jia et al., 2025；Du et al., 2024）。 基于粒子、网格和图的学习动力学方法能够捕捉模拟原生表示中的局部相互作用，但它们的主要预测空间并非全域密集欧拉体积（Pfaff et al., 2020；Gaoa et al., 2025）。 类似地，场景流方法可以估计三维运动场，但其目标在于场景或点运动，而非物理上显式的液体状态预测（Li et al., 2023a；Vedder et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2025）。 综合来看，这些局限性凸显了在全域液体响应预测中处理时变固体相互作用这一尚未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce a benchmark for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting and propose a recurrent forecasting framework with two levels. TIDE ( T emporal I nterface- D riven liquid field E stimator) isolates the localized interface-driven forecasting principle: solid-induced updates should be generated where the interaction occurs and then propagated through rollout. TIDES retains this localized core and augments it with transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization for robust long-horizon forecasting.

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark and shared evaluation protocol are designed for this task. Since no standard benchmark or exact task-matched baseline exists for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting, we compare against task-necessity baselines, adapted neighboring baselines, and controlled within-family ablations under a shared forecasting protocol, following the broader emphasis on rollout, physical fidelity, OOD generalization, and benchmarked scientific forecasting ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试和共享评估协议都是为这项任务而设计的。 由于目前尚无针对移动固体条件下稠密液体预测的标准基准测试或完全匹配任务基线，因此我们采用共享的预测协议，将模型与任务必要性基线、经过调整的邻近基线以及受控的同类消融模型进行比较，同时遵循对滚动预测、物理保真度、域外泛化能力和基准化科学预测的广泛关注（Yang et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments reveal a clear modeling hierarchy. paragraphs.en: A large body of work studies learned surrogates for PDEs and fluid dynamics, especially through neural operator frameworks such as FNO, U-NO, U-FNO, and Geo-FNO ( Li et al., 2020 ; Kovachki et al., 2023 ; Rahman et al., 2022 ; Wen et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ) . These models have shown strong performance in operator regression, multiscale prediction, and geometry-aware field modeling ( Li et al., 2023c ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Rabeh et al., 2025 ) . However, they are typically designed for operator regression or geometry-conditioned surrogate prediction. In contrast, our setting requires forecasting a dense liquid rollout under time-varying solid motion, where object–fluid exchange occurs through an evolving interaction interface.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究探讨了偏微分方程（PDE）和流体动力学的学习型代理模型，尤其是通过神经算子框架，例如 FNO、U-NO、U-FNO 和 Geo-FNO（Li et al., 2020；Kovachki et al., 2023；Rahman et al., 2022；Wen et al., 2022；Li et al., 2023b）。 这些模型在算子回归、多尺度预测和几何感知场建模方面表现出强劲的性能（Li et al., 2023c；Wu et al., 2024；Wen et al., 2025；Rabeh et al., 2025）。 然而，它们通常是为算子回归或几何条件代理预测而设计的。 相比之下，我们的设定需要预测在随时间变化的固体运动下稠密液体的演化过程，其中物体与流体之间的交换通过不断演化的相互作用界面发生。

paragraphs.en: Another related line of work learns 3D spatiotemporal velocity fields in scientific and medical settings. For example, 4DFlowNet and related methods use CFD-assisted supervision to super-resolve or denoise 4D flow MRI ( Ferdian et al., 2020 ; Rutkowski et al., 2021 ) . These methods show that volumetric velocity fields and local structures such as near-wall behavior can be learned effectively ( Rutkowski et al., 2021 ; Suk et al., 2026 ) . However, they enhance or reconstruct already observed flow measurements, whereas we forecast future liquid response conditioned on changing solid motion and occupancy.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项相关研究则在科学和医学领域学习三维时空速度场。 例如，4DFlowNet 及相关方法利用计算流体力学（CFD）辅助的监督，对四维流动 MRI 进行超分辨率重建或降噪（Ferdian 等，2020；Rutkowski 等，2021）。 这些方法表明，体积速度场以及近壁行为等局部结构可以被有效学习（Rutkowski 等，2021；Suk 等，2026）。 然而，这些方法是对已观测到的流动测量值进行增强或重建，而我们的方法则是基于变化的固体运动和占据状态来预测液体的未来响应。

paragraphs.en: Work on fluid–solid interaction highlights the importance of coupling through boundaries or interfaces rather than uniform global updates ( Kolahdouz et al., 2021 ; Zhong and Meidani, 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . Classical FSI formulations and recent interface-aware learning methods both support this view ( Kolahdouz et al., 2021 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, particle-graph simulators such as GNS and mesh-based learned simulators such as MeshGraphNets provide strong inductive biases for local interaction and transport-consistent dynamics ( Pfaff et al., 2020 ; Midlagajni and Rothkopf, 2025 ) . Our work draws on these insights but targets a different prediction space: dense Eulerian liquid velocity rollout, using Lagrangian transport only as a coupled consistency mechanism rather than as the primary output.
paragraphs.zh: 对流体-固体相互作用的研究凸显了通过边界或界面进行耦合的重要性，而非采用统一的全局更新（Kolahdouz 等人，2021；Zhong 和 Meidani，2025；Xiao 等人，2024）。 经典的流体-固体相互作用建模方法以及近期的界面感知学习方法都支持这一观点（Kolahdouz 等人，2021；Tao 等人，2026）。 与此同时，粒子图模拟器（如 GNS）和基于网格的学习型模拟器（如 MeshGraphNets）为局部相互作用和符合输运规律的动态过程提供了强大的归纳偏置（Pfaff 等人，2020；Midlagajni 和 Rothkopf，2025）。 我们的工作借鉴了这些见解，但针对不同的预测空间：即稠密的欧拉液体速度演化预测，其中仅将拉格朗日输运作为耦合一致性机制，而非主要输出。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks emphasize evaluating scientific forecasting beyond one-step regression accuracy ( Koehler et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . APEBench highlights rollout-based and long-horizon evaluation for PDE emulators ( Koehler et al., 2024 ) , while ML4CFD stresses accuracy, physical fidelity, out-of-distribution generalization, and efficiency ( Yagoubi et al., 2025 ) . This is especially relevant for interactive solid–fluid forecasting, where local interface errors can accumulate into transport or stability failures over autoregressive rollout. Since no exact task-matched benchmark exists for our setting, we evaluate adapted neighboring baselines and controlled within-family ablations under a shared protocol to isolate necessary modeling ingredients.

paragraphs.en: Because no standard benchmark exists for this exact task, we use a metric suite adapted from autoregressive PDE forecasting, transport-sensitive evaluation, and physics-aware diagnostics. We treat rollout field error ( l roll l_{\mathrm{roll}} ), near-interface field error ( near \mathrm{near} ), and transport endpoint error ( t ​ r ​ a ​ j end traj_{\mathrm{end}} ) as the primary forecasting metrics, since they measure overall rollout quality, interaction-region accuracy, and material transport consistency. We additionally report far-field error ( far \mathrm{far} ) for propagation behavior and divergence delta ( Δ div \Delta_{\mathrm{div}} ) as a stabilization-oriented diagnostic, not as a standalone measure of physical fidelity. Since field metrics are normalized voxel averages, we emphasize consistent ranking, cross-metric tradeoffs, and robustness under OOD and long-horizon evaluation rather than raw decimal scale alone.
paragraphs.zh: 由于目前尚无针对这一具体任务的标准基准，我们采用了一套从自回归 PDE 预测、传输敏感评估和物理感知诊断中改编而来的指标组合。 我们将展开场误差（ l roll l_{\mathrm{roll}} ）、近界面场误差（ near \mathrm{near} ）和传输终点误差（ t ​ r ​ a ​ j end traj_{\mathrm{end}} ）作为主要预测指标，因为它们分别衡量整体展开质量、相互作用区域的准确性以及材料传输的一致性。 此外，我们还报告远场误差（ far \mathrm{far} ）以评估传播行为，并将发散差值（ Δ div \Delta_{\mathrm{div}} ）作为面向稳定性的诊断指标，而非独立的物理保真度衡量标准。 由于场指标是归一化的体素平均值，我们更强调排名的一致性、不同指标之间的权衡关系，以及在 OOD 和长期预测评估下的稳健性，而不仅仅是关注原始数值的大小。

paragraphs.en: Since no standard benchmark or exact task-matched baseline exists, Table 2 is organized to answer complementary comparison questions rather than to present a single exact-competitor ranking. Bulk Only tests whether dense liquid rollout can be predicted without explicit moving-solid conditioning. The adapted 3D ResUNet , U-NO , Transolver , and GNS baselines anchor the benchmark against neighboring volumetric, neural-operator, transformer-based, and particle model families ( Rahman et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Pfaff et al., 2020 ; Midlagajni and Rothkopf, 2025 ) . Our variants then test the modeling hierarchy within the proposed family: TIDE uses the localized interface-driven core, Finite Support widens the localized residual support as an exploratory variant, and TIDES adds transport-aware feedback and stabilization.
paragraphs.zh: 由于目前尚无标准的基准测试或完全匹配任务基线，表2的组织方式旨在回答相互补充的比较问题，而非呈现单一的精确竞争对手排名。 “仅批量”测试检验了是否可以在没有明确移动固体条件约束的情况下预测密集液体展开过程。 经过调整的 3D ResUNet、U-NO、Transolver 和 GNS 基线为基准测试提供了与邻近体积模型、神经算子、基于变换器的模型以及粒子模型家族（Rahman 等，2022；Wu 等，2024；Pfaff 等，2020；Midlagajni 和 Rothkopf，2025）的对比参照。 我们的变体随后检验了所提出模型家族内部的建模层次结构：TIDE 使用局部化的界面驱动核心，Finite Support 作为探索性变体扩展了局部化残差支持范围，而 TIDES 则增加了传输感知反馈和稳定机制。

paragraphs.en: The main pattern is the progression from no explicit interaction modeling to localized interaction modeling and then to stabilized transport-aware rollout. Bulk Only is weaker than the interaction-aware variants, showing that the moving solid cannot be treated as incidental context. TIDE improves the primary forecasting metrics relative to the adapted external references and the widened-support variant, which supports localized interface conditioning as the core inductive bias. TIDES further reduces rollout, interface, far-field, and trajectory errors while producing the clearest stabilization diagnostic, suggesting that transport-aware feedback and correction modules matter once the localized core is used autoregressively.
paragraphs.zh: 主要模式是从没有显式交互建模，到局部交互建模，再到稳定的、考虑传输的展开过程的演进。 “仅批量”方法弱于考虑交互的变体，这表明移动的固体不能被视为附带背景信息。 TIDE 相对于适配的外部参考和扩展支持变体而言，提升了主要预测指标，这支持将局部接口条件设定为核心归纳偏置的观点。 TIDES 进一步减少了展开、接口、远场和轨迹误差，同时产生了最清晰的稳定诊断结果，这表明一旦局部核心被自回归地使用，考虑传输的反馈和修正模块就至关重要。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two distribution shifts and one horizon extension. Motion/trajectory OOD uses unseen combinations of path length, speed, acceleration/deceleration, and straight/curved trajectories. Size OOD doubles sphere and cone radius and cube edge length at test time while keeping all models trained on the original dense benchmark. Horizon extension evaluates models trained at rollout length 8 at rollout lengths 16 and 24. Tables 10 , 11 , and 12 in appendix G report these results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了两种分布偏移和一种时间步长扩展。 运动/轨迹 OOD 使用了路径长度、速度、加速/减速以及直线/曲线轨迹的未见过的组合。 尺寸 OOD 在测试时将球体和圆锥体的半径以及立方体的边长加倍，同时所有模型均基于原始密集基准数据集进行训练。 时间步长扩展评估了在 rollout 长度为 8 时训练的模型在 rollout 长度为 16 和 24 时的表现。 附录 G 中的表 10、11 和 12 报告了这些结果。

paragraphs.en: The OOD and horizon results are consistent with the main comparison. TIDES gives the best aggregate behavior on motion OOD, size OOD, and both longer horizons, with the clearest stabilization diagnostic. TIDE remains competitive as the localized core, while external baselines can match isolated metrics but do not match the combined rollout, transport, and stabilization behavior. These results suggest that transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization become most useful as distribution shift or accumulated rollout error increases.
paragraphs.zh: OOD 和时域结果与主要对比结果一致。 TIDES 在运动 OOD、尺寸 OOD 以及更长的时域中均表现出最佳的整体性能，并且其稳定性诊断结果最为清晰。 TIDE 作为局部化核心仍具有竞争力，而外部基线模型虽然能在个别指标上与之匹敌，却无法匹配其综合的展开、传输和稳定性表现。 这些结果表明，随着分布偏移或累积展开误差的增加，具备传输感知的耦合机制和显式稳定性控制会变得最为有效。

paragraphs.en: Our results support a local-to-global view of moving-solid-conditioned liquid forecasting: the interaction is initiated at the evolving solid–liquid interface, but the target is a full-domain Eulerian rollout. This is consistent with classical and learned FSI perspectives, where solid–fluid exchange is mediated through moving interfaces or boundary conditions ( Kolahdouz et al., 2021 ; Zhong and Meidani, 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . The experiments indicate that localized interface modeling provides the core forecasting mechanism, while transport-aware feedback and explicit stabilization improve robustness under autoregressive rollout, OOD motion/size shifts, and horizon extension ( Koehler et al., 2024 ; Yagoubi et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果支持一种从局部到全局的移动固体条件液体预测方法：相互作用始于不断演变的固液界面，但预测目标是整个域的欧拉场演化。 这与经典和基于学习的固液相互作用（FSI）观点一致，即固体与流体的交换通过移动界面或边界条件进行调节（Kolahdouz 等，2021；Zhong 和 Meidani，2025；Tao 等，2026）。 实验表明，局部界面建模提供了核心的预测机制，而考虑输运过程的反馈和显式稳定化方法则提升了自回归演化、分布外运动/尺寸变化以及预测时间范围扩展情况下的鲁棒性（Koehler 等，2024；Yagoubi 等，2025；Hu 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: This benchmark should be interpreted as a controlled study rather than a replacement for physical simulation. The data are synthetic, the OOD axes are limited to motion and object-size shifts, and the dense Eulerian target is constructed from particle simulations rather than measured as a solver-native continuum field. Similar sim-to-real and benchmark-coverage limitations have been discussed in recent scientific ML benchmarks ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Future work should extend the task to richer geometries, broader physical parameter shifts, multi-solid interactions, and more practical repeated-query liquid forecasting.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试应被理解为一项受控研究，而非对物理模拟的替代。 这些数据是合成的，OOD 轴仅限于运动和物体尺寸的变化，而密集欧拉目标则是通过粒子模拟构建的，而非作为求解器原生的连续场进行测量。 类似的从模拟到现实的转换以及基准测试覆盖范围方面的局限性，已在近期的科学机器学习基准测试中有所讨论（Hu et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2025）。 未来的工作应将任务扩展到更复杂的几何结构、更广泛的物理参数变化、多固体相互作用，以及更具实用性的重复查询液体预测。

paragraphs.en: We formulated interactive 4D volumetric liquid forecasting as a moving-solid-conditioned dense prediction task: given a current liquid state and a known future solid motion, the model forecasts the future full-domain Eulerian liquid velocity rollout. Across the controlled benchmark, our results identify localized interface-driven interaction as the central modeling principle, and show that transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization improve long-horizon autoregressive forecasting. We hope this task, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study provide a foundation for broader research on motion-conditioned liquid forecasting under richer geometries, broader distribution shifts, and more practical repeated-query settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将交互式4D体素液体预测建模为一个以移动固体为条件的密集预测任务：给定当前的液体状态和已知的未来固体运动，模型可预测未来整个域内的欧拉液体速度演化。 在整个受控基准测试中，我们的结果指出局部化的界面驱动相互作用是核心建模原则，并表明考虑传输的耦合与显式稳定化能够提升长期自回归预测效果。 我们希望这项任务、该基准测试以及TIDE/TIDES研究能为更广泛的研究奠定基础，包括在更复杂的几何结构、更广泛的分布偏移以及更具实用性的重复查询场景下，开展以运动为条件的液体预测研究。

paragraphs.en: All external baselines are trained against the same dense voxelized forecasting target used in the main benchmark: next-step Eulerian liquid velocity on the shared grid. The two voxel-space baselines, 3D ResUNet and U-NO , receive the current liquid velocity together with global grid-aligned solid-conditioning channels derived from the future solid state. These channels encode solid-state cues such as boundary velocity and interface proximity, but the models do not use the localized mediator pathway, transport-feedback pathway, or explicit stabilization modules of the finalized method.
paragraphs.zh: 所有外部基线模型均基于主基准测试中使用的相同密集体素化预测目标进行训练：即共享网格上的下一步欧拉液体速度。 两种体素空间基线模型——3D ResUNet 和 U-NO——接收当前液体速度，以及从未来固体状态中提取的、与全局网格对齐的固体条件通道。 这些通道编码了固体状态的提示信息，例如边界速度和界面邻近性，但这些模型并未使用最终方法中的局部中介路径、传输反馈路径或显式稳定化模块。

paragraphs.en: For Transolver , we use the same voxelized liquid input but concatenate a global solid-conditioning grid composed of voxelized boundary velocity and fluid–solid interface channels before applying full-grid physics-attention. For GNS , we preserve native Lagrangian particle prediction by representing the moving solid as kinematic rigid proxy particles and compute voxel-space metrics only after rasterizing predicted particle velocities onto the shared Eulerian grid. Unless otherwise noted, the same dense target-construction protocol is used for all methods so that every baseline is scored in the same prediction space.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Transolver，我们使用相同的体素化液体输入，但在应用全网格物理注意力之前，会拼接一个由体素化边界速度和流体-固体界面通道组成的全局固体条件化网格。 对于 GNS，我们通过将移动的固体表示为运动学刚性代理粒子来保留其本原的拉格朗日粒子预测，并且仅在将预测的粒子速度栅格化到共享的欧拉网格之后，才计算体素空间中的指标。 除非另有说明，所有方法均使用相同的密集目标构建协议，以确保每个基线模型都在同一预测空间中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The reported runs use the following DualSPHysics numerical ingredients. The smoothing kernel is the Quintic Wendland kernel. Dissipation is handled with Monaghan artificial viscosity . Density noise is reduced with the Fourtakas density-diffusion term. Particle disorder is controlled with the Lind et al. shifting algorithm. paragraphs.en: One implementation detail matters for interpreting boundary accuracy. The template XML is authored with Boundary=2 , i.e. the modified dynamic boundary condition (mDBC), but the runtime case script switches the reported rigid closed-tank runs to Boundary=1 , i.e. the classic dynamic boundary condition (DBC), because mDBC normal generation can fail in this enclosed floating-body setup. Thus, the benchmark should be understood as using the standard DualSPHysics WCSPH free-surface formulation together with a robust DBC rigid-wall treatment for the finalized rigid-object dataset. This is still a physically coupled CFD simulation, but it is not the most aggressive boundary-accuracy setting available in the general solver.

paragraphs.en: The benchmark input contract should be distinguished from the simulator internals. During simulation, the rigid object follows a realized fluid-coupled rigid-body trajectory under the runtime forcing schedule. After simulation, this realized future solid-state sequence is recorded and provided to the forecasting model as known conditioning. The model therefore receives future solid states but never future liquid states. In this sense, the benchmark assumes a known future moving-solid sequence and evaluates only the problem of forecasting the liquid response to that sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 基准输入合同应与模拟器的内部机制区分开来。 在模拟过程中，刚性物体遵循在运行时强制调度下实现的流体耦合刚性体轨迹。 模拟结束后，这一已实现的未来固态序列会被记录，并作为已知条件提供给预测模型。 因此，该模型接收的是未来的固态，但从未接收未来的液态。 从这个意义上说，基准假设了一个已知的未来移动固态序列，并且仅评估预测液体对该序列响应的这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We therefore treat the simulator output as a high-fidelity reference rather than as exact ground truth. This is justified because DualSPHysics is a mature research and engineering code with extensive validations against analytical solutions, numerical benchmarks, and experimental data, and because WCSPH is particularly well matched to violent free-surface flow, splashing, and moving solid interaction. At the same time, the reference remains a numerical approximation: it inherits the assumptions of weak compressibility, artificial dissipation, boundary modelling, particle shifting, and finite resolution. In addition, our benchmark applies a separate particle-to-voxel target-construction stage, and some dataset-generation variants optionally add low-amplitude ambient surface perturbations during post-processing. For transparency, the dataset contract stores both raw and post-processed velocity fields when such perturbations are used, so that solver-native and augmented signals remain distinguishable.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将模拟器的输出视为高保真参考，而非精确的基准真相。 这样做是有充分理由的：DualSPHysics 是一款成熟的研究与工程代码，已通过大量分析解、数值基准和实验数据的验证；此外，WCSPH 尤其适用于剧烈自由表面流、飞溅以及移动固体相互作用等场景。 同时，该参考值仍然是一种数值近似：它继承了弱可压缩性、人工耗散、边界建模、粒子位移和有限分辨率等假设。 此外，我们的基准测试采用了一个独立的粒子到体素的目标构建阶段，某些数据集生成变体还会在后期处理中可选地添加低振幅的环境表面扰动。 为保持透明度，当使用此类扰动时，数据集合同时会存储原始和后处理的流速场，以便区分求解器原生信号与增强后的信号。

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper motivates positive uses in robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, simulation-driven design, and rigid–fluid content generation. paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文阐述了该技术在机器人液体操控、数字孪生、模拟驱动设计以及刚体–流体内容生成方面的积极应用。 同时，文章也通过强调该基准测试是一项受控的预测研究，而非物理模拟的替代方案，从而限制了其主张的范围，这有助于降低过度宣称部署就绪的风险。
